name: freehold
title: Freehold
author: bits-orio
description: Land rights, earned cell by cell. Every cell climbs a ladder - Wilderness to Trail to Rampart to Deed - and the engine itself enforces what you may build where. Inspired by Gridlocked by _CodeGreen - reimagined from scratch with tiered land rights, a land economy, and first-class Multi-Team Support integration.
